correctness.rationale: Orbit-centroid fixed-point triangulation and exact coset maximum-distance formulas prove all PL filtration models for every real scale and all stated groups. For the exceptional two-coordinate translation, a subcomplex homotopy equivalent to a cube graph is supplemented by explicit triangles filling all cubical square relations at scale three; all later edges homotope into this stage by distance-shortening triangles. This proves simple connectivity for every scale at least three, and hence all stated low-degree barcodes. The connected graph chain exact sequence proves the integral normalizer character, including reversal signs. The executable finite checker on the actual package paths independently tested 89 all-scale coset models, 6 graph sizes, mod-two boundary ranks and 116 symmetry-character actions. Boundary cases with zero cube coordinates and vanishing rank are included; finite checks are only corroboration.

value.rationale: The natural geometric fixed-space persistence of the binary Hamming cube is not determined by ambient Rips homotopy, ambient equivariant homology, or a single fixed radius-two graph. A complete exact classification of the reduced first two homological degrees across three structurally different subgroup types gives sharp delayed births/deaths and a nontrivial integral residual symmetry lattice. This supplies usable information about fixed-point filtration maps and group actions with exponentially growing ranks, not merely a normalization or a small isolated table.
